name: hepi-mono
description: Monorepo for HEPI Pi Coding Agent extensions.

scripts.check: bun run build:aggregates && biome check . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.base.json && bun run test:hepi
scripts.build:aft-pi: bun install --cwd third_party/aft --no-save && bun run --cwd third_party/aft/packages/pi-plugin build
scripts.build:magic-context: bun install --cwd third_party/magic-context --no-save && bun run --cwd third_party/magic-context/packages/pi-plugin build
scripts.build:aggregates: bun run build:aft-pi && bun run build:magic-context && bun scripts/build-aggregate.mjs --all
scripts.test: bun run build:aggregates && bun run test:hepi
scripts.test:hepi: bun test --max-concurrency=1 --path-ignore-patterns='third_party/**' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-basics/test/tui-replay.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-tools/test/ask/component.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns='packages/hepi-basics/test/ui/render.test.ts' && bun test packages/hepi-basics/test/tui-replay.test.ts && bun test packages/hepi-tools/test/ask/component.test.ts && bun test packages/hepi-basics/test/ui/render.test.ts
